# Elessar

> Elessar (`elessar` on PyPI) is an MIT-licensed Python library for automated exploratory data analysis (EDA) and data-quality profiling. Requires Python >=3.10. Install with `pip install elessar`; start with `import elessar` and `elessar.see(data)`.

Documented version: 1.1.0. Package source: https://github.com/Thibautdqb/elessar/tree/2262600bc335e535297bfc64b05b646e6172590f.

## Documentation

- [Overview](https://elessar-python.fizzyknoll28.chatgpt.site/): capabilities, installation and scope.
- [Quickstart](https://elessar-python.fizzyknoll28.chatgpt.site/quickstart/): a complete pandas example and CLI usage.
- [Python API](https://elessar-python.fizzyknoll28.chatgpt.site/api/): see, load, focused analysis functions, StoneConfig and Vision.
- [Data quality](https://elessar-python.fizzyknoll28.chatgpt.site/guides/data-quality/): missing values, duplicates and semantic types.
- [Large datasets and inputs](https://elessar-python.fizzyknoll28.chatgpt.site/guides/large-datasets/): formats, streaming and sampling limits.
- [Full Markdown reference](https://elessar-python.fizzyknoll28.chatgpt.site/reference.md): compact package facts and examples in plain text.
- [Documentation en français](https://elessar-python.fizzyknoll28.chatgpt.site/fr/): présentation et démarrage rapide.

## Primary package sources

- [PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/elessar/): release files and installation metadata.
- [GitHub](https://github.com/Thibautdqb/elessar): code, README, changelog and issue tracker.
- [Statistical validation](https://github.com/Thibautdqb/elessar/blob/main/VALIDATION.md): methods and limitations.
